Starting the Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. I'll systematically evaluate the home feed, category pages, navigation, and mobile experience, then compile a comprehensive report with screenshots.

I have completed the Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. The site has some excellent features like the Economics heatmap and the MLB championship grid, but there are several critical bugs affecting data quality and loading. 

The most severe issues include future games being marked as "FINAL" with 0-0 scores, the weather page and golf grid failing to load data (showing only skeleton placeholders), and a race condition causing golf probabilities to temporarily render as 0%.

I've compiled all findings into a detailed report and attached it along with the requested screenshots. Let me know if you need any further analysis!
